decision_cruda.rationale: LH-01 and LH-02 are down (radio and CMMS agree), and repairs won't finish before 12:30–15:30. Both stopes are high grade (11.9 and 10.9 g/t) in Norte. Norte has stockpile room (242/450) and trucks have spare capacity. LH-08 comes from the infrastructure heading, which costs only 0.2 oz/h. It reaches N600-09 in 0.65 h and loads about 160 t, roughly 61 oz. LH-10 leaves preventive maintenance at 11:00, so it has no home production to lose. It reaches N522-15 in 0.65 h and loads about 135 t, roughly 47 oz. I left LH-09 on its critical-path heading at 4 oz/h. I did not pull loaders from other producing stopes. No reserve activations because no stope has stopped.

violaciones: LH-10 no se puede prestar (caído, en mantenimiento o en ciclo combinado)
